chunks: 2666 - And Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who touched perfume forgetfully while he was in iḥrām. He said: “He should wash his hands, recite the talbiyah, and there is nothing upon him.”
And in another report: “And he should seek forgiveness from his Lord.”

key_terms.الطِّيبَ: perfume or fragrance prohibited for the muḥrim to use
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of iḥrām for hajj or ʿumrah
key_terms.يَغْسِلُ: he should wash, here referring to cleansing the hands

ai.seo_question: What should a person in iḥrām do if he uses perfume forgetfully?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a muḥrim who touches perfume forgetfully during iḥrām. The ruling is that he should wash his hands, recite the talbiyah, and no penalty is due upon him; another report adds that he should seek forgiveness from his Lord.
